# Synthetic audit fixture: personal names (SPEC §27) behind the
# identifying name-field labels — the personal/full/real name family in
# every case and separator spelling (the label machinery matches a
# lowercased copy of the line). The bare `name` key is deliberately NOT a
# label: it is an ordinary key everywhere in code and HCL. The value
# anchor is a NAME SHAPE, not positional: two-or-more word runs of name
# characters, each run 3-plus, totalling 8-plus — so prose pairs like
# "the name" (3+4) stay silent while any real two-run name fires, and
# very short names ("Jan Li", 3+2) stay silent too (documented,
# acceptable miss). Synthetic values.
Personal Name: Alice Smith
full_name = "Jean-Pierre Blanc"
"full_name": "Mary Jane Watson"
REAL-NAME:=O'Brien Casey
personalName: Jeanne D'Arc-Lee
full name = Jean Pierre Dupont
# Bare-name, single-token, short, placeholder, prose and form-boilerplate
# forms that must stay silent.
name = "Alice Smith"
full_name: Smith
full name: Jan Li
personal_name = <your name>
Full Name: Not Applicable
personal_name: …
Personal Name: the name of the person
real_name = var.instance_name
Personal Name: Élodie Durand
